text_layer_match: Text-layer match on the recorded page. This mark locates the saved excerpt in the PDF’s text layer. Compare it with the page image; placement does not verify the claim or establish that the text is visible as printed.
page_only: Page shown without a passage mark. Compare the saved excerpt with the page image.
scope_first_page: This entry concerns a broader recorded source scope. Only its starting page is shown, without a passage mark.
docx: This manuscript was submitted as DOCX. Word page layout is not available for this source.

unavailable.assessment_revision_unverified: The saved assessment revision is unknown; no source image is attached.
unavailable.source_identity_unverified: The original source identity was not recorded; no source image is attached.
unavailable.bounded_excerpt_only: Only the saved comparison excerpt is included; the other manuscript’s original page is not shared.
unavailable.source_changed: The original source no longer matches the saved evidence; no source image is attached.
unavailable.source_mutated: The source could not be kept unchanged while reading; no source image is attached.
unavailable.location_unavailable: The recorded source location could not be shown as a PDF page.
unavailable.resource_limit: Source image omitted because this request’s configured image limit was reached. The saved excerpt and location remain shown.
unavailable.public_page_annotations: This source page contains PDF annotations, links or form fields and is withheld from public sharing.
unavailable.public_page_inspection_unavailable: This source page could not be inspected for public sharing and is withheld.
